review_questions: Independently falsify the repaired web-first TESTING→RELEASE_CANDIDATE→PRODUCTION boundary. Do not inherit authority from R2-001 PASS; that review was later falsified by an authority-source defect.
Verify v2 no longer accepts caller-declared production credential domain or current-head strings as authority and instead validates platform-owned HMAC attestations.
Verify Production Authorization issuance requires exact bound authorization evidence and cannot be forged/rebound without the platform authority key.
Verify production receipts can only be minted from an actually production-eligible decision and rollback requires a valid signed prior production receipt rather than an unused authorization.
Verify original build-once/artifact-continuity, evidence/provenance binding, ordered transition, expiry, model non-authority and deterministic replay semantics remain regression-clean.
Verify CI run 34270161942 is bound to exact candidate 6a4a729144e33fc5b7e8c5048935676d6f88d814 and both PB-01..PB-16 and PB2-01..PB2-18 pass.

Search specifically for HMAC trust-root misuse, record-type confusion, signature replay across namespaces, authorization/receipt rebinding, stale head/credential attestations, arbitrary authority issuance paths, and overclaim beyond a reference trust boundary.
Return PASS only if every mandatory dimension is TESTED_SUPPORTED and no MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL finding remains.

evidence_refs.ref: Candidate bb2a591d6fa9d6da507d6ff6aa8f444784a57651 passed authenticated R2-001, but post-review adversarial inspection found HIGH authority-source false-green: caller-supplied credential_domain/current_head_sha and arbitrary authorization evidence digest could appear authoritative. That PASS grants no authority to this repaired candidate.

Initial R2-001 provider attempt run 34269375451 failed with OpenRouter/Nvidia 502 temporarily overloaded; authority NONE. Retry classifier was repaired narrowly and exact request retry run 34269571081 passed before the later semantic false-green was discovered.

required_review_dimensions.description: Exact repaired candidate is based on Slice5 main and contains the frozen promotion boundary plus preregistered authority-source repair, preserved false-green evidence, v2 mechanism/tests and workflow.
Production eligibility requires a valid platform-signed head attestation for the exact source SHA; caller-declared head strings cannot satisfy authority.
Production credential authority requires a valid platform-signed credential attestation for production domain/environment; testing or forged credentials fail closed.
Production Authorization is platform-issued, signature-bound to exact RC/source/artifact and bound PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION evidence; forgery/rebinding is denied.
Production receipt is platform-signed and mintable only from a production-eligible decision; rollback requires a signed prior production receipt and unused authorization alone is insufficient.
Original build-once exact-artifact continuity, exact evidence/provenance binding, ordered TESTING→RC→PRODUCTION transition, expiry and head-drift semantics remain enforced.
Model/reviewer claims and untrusted caller strings cannot mint or widen production authority.
HMAC records enforce record type and authority namespace and tamper/rebinding attempts fail closed; trust-root assumptions remain explicitly bounded.
Run 34270161942 is bound to exact candidate and executes both original 16 and repaired 18 adversarial cases without provider/production secrets.
Claims remain a deterministic reference trust/promotion boundary only, not production KMS/HSM/hosting/deployment/security; adversarial inspection finds no material remaining bypass.
